toolCall.argumentsJson: {"CommandLine":"node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); const tags=[]; const regex=/\u003c(\\/?)([a-zA-Z0-9]+)[^\u003e]*\u003e/g; let m; while((m=regex.exec(html))!==null){ const isClose=m[1]==='/'; const tag=m[2].toLowerCase(); if(['meta','link','input','img','br','hr','source','path','svg','polyline','line','circle','rect'].includes(tag)) continue; if(!isClose){ tags.push({tag, line: html.substring(0,m.index).split('\\n').length}); }else{ if(tags.length===0){console.log('Extra close at line', html.substring(0,m.index).split('\\n').length, tag);continue;} const last=tags.pop(); if(last.tag!==tag){console.log('Mismatch at line', html.substring(0,m.index).split('\\n').length, 'expected closing', last.tag, 'but got', tag, '(opened at line', last.line, ')');} } } for(let t of tags) console.log('Unclosed', t.tag, 'opened at line', t.line);\"","Cwd":"d:\\AI\\Antigravity","WaitMsBeforeAsync":1000,"toolAction":"Find unclosed divs","toolSummary":"Parse HTML"}
